Fields.Description: Citation rendering mode for summaries produced by this template: PageNumber (0) shows inline page references (e.g. [p. 5]); Highlight (1) shows clickable highlight markers backed by Deep RAG highlight coordinates.

Fields.Name: IngestionSourceId
Fields.Description: FK reference to MRS2IngestionSource.SourceId. Links this template to its configured ingestion source for automated file discovery.

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: User-provided description of the template's purpose and intended use case.

Fields.Name: WorkflowId
Fields.Description: FK to MRSWorkflow.WorkflowId. Selects the workflow whose MRSCustomStatus rows populate the Complete Review dropdown for records of this template. Null = built-in default workflow (Approve/Reject).

Fields.Name: StorageBucketFolderId
Fields.Description: Numeric ID of the Storage Bucket folder associated with this template. Used for file operations and ingestion routing.

Fields.Name: ManualReviewEstimatedTimeInMinutes
Fields.Description: Estimated time in minutes that a manual review typically takes for this template. Combined with ManualReviewEstimatedTimeType, used to compute the time saved by AI summarization.

Fields.Name: CreatedDate
Fields.Description: Application-managed creation date. Preserves original date during migration. New records set this to current timestamp.

Fields.Name: TemplateId
Fields.Description: Business key for the template. Generated when a new template is created. Referenced by MRS2TemplateVersion.TemplateId.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: User-facing name of the template. Displayed in the template list and selection UI.

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether this template is active and available for use. Inactive templates are hidden from the template selection UI but retained for historical reference.

Fields.Name: AgentCategory
Fields.Description: Category classification for the AI agent used by this template (e.g., medical_records, clinical_summary). Used for filtering and routing.

Data.Name: MRS2Output
Data.Description: Core output record representing a single processed medical record. Contains status, file references, and AI-generated content attachments. Split from the original MRSOutput god entity — assignment state lives in MRS2OutputAssignment.

Fields.Name: OverrideFile
Fields.Description: File attachment containing JSON override history. Stores reviewer edits to the AI-generated summary. Single source of truth — replaces the dual MRSOutputOverride text field and MRSOutputOverrideFile file.

Fields.Name: SummaryFile
Fields.Description: File attachment containing the AI-generated markdown summary. Single source of truth — replaces the dual MRSAnalysisOutput text field and MRSDeepRagSummary file.

Fields.Name: ExportFile
Fields.Description: File attachment containing the exported output document (e.g., DOCX or PDF). Generated when a reviewer exports the finalized summary.

Fields.Name: PacketFile
Fields.Description: File attachment containing the original source PDF packet. Stored as a Data Fabric attachment for direct access without Storage Bucket round-trips.

Fields.Name: TemplateVersionId
Fields.Description: FK reference to MRS2TemplateVersion.TemplateVersionId. Identifies which template version was used to generate this output.

Fields.Name: CurrentAssigneeId
Fields.Description: Denormalized current assignee user ID. Updated on assign/reassign. Avoids join with OutputAssignment for list display.

Fields.Name: SourceFileName
Fields.Description: Denormalized source filename for display. Set at creation from the ingestion file's FileName.

Fields.Name: InstanceId
Fields.Description: Orchestrator job instance ID — used to trace back to the job logs in Orchestrator for this record.

Fields.Name: CurrentAssigneeName
Fields.Description: Denormalized current assignee display name. Updated on assign/reassign.

Fields.Name: CreatedDate
Fields.Description: Application-managed creation date. Preserves original date during migration. New records set this to current timestamp.

Fields.Name: CompletedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp when a reviewer marked this output as completed or approved. Null until review is finalized.

Fields.Name: ProcessedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp when AI processing completed and the summary was generated. Null while status is pending or processing.

Fields.Name: ReviewNote
Fields.Description: Free-text reviewer note captured at Complete Review time. Persisted alongside CustomOutputStatusId to record the reviewer's justification for the workflow status they picked.

Fields.Name: TemplateId
Fields.Description: Denormalized template ID for filtering. Avoids join through TemplateVersion to resolve template.

Fields.Name: ErrorMessage
Fields.Description: Error details when OutputStatus is faulted. Contains the exception message from the processing pipeline.

Fields.Name: ContextGroundingId
Fields.Description: Reference ID for the UiPath Context Grounding index entry for this output. Used to retrieve RAG-based citations. Renamed from MRSDeepRagSummaryId.

Fields.Name: IngestionFileId
Fields.Description: FK reference to MRS2IngestionFile.IngestionFileId. Links this output to the source ingestion file that was processed.

Fields.Name: ManualBatchId
Fields.Description: FK reference to MRS2ManualBatch.ManualBatchId. Present only when this output was created from a manual batch upload. Null for automated ingestion outputs.

Fields.Name: MRSPacketLocation
Fields.Description: File path within the storage bucket where the source PDF lives (e.g. folder/2026-04-10T12-00-00/file.pdf). Used by the viewer to load the PDF directly from the bucket.

Fields.Name: MaestroTraceId
Fields.Description: Maestro trace ID used for LLMOps trace correlation. Set by the backend after AI processing completes.

Fields.Name: StartedWorkingAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp when a reviewer started working on this output. Denormalized from MRS2OutputAssignment for query performance (review time stats).

Fields.Name: OutputId
Fields.Description: Business key for the output record. Generated by the backend when a new output is created. Used as the FK reference from MRS2OutputAssignment and MRS2AssignmentHistory.

Fields.Name: PageCount
Fields.Description: Number of pages in the source PDF that was processed. Set by the processing pipeline after PDF analysis.

Fields.Name: TemplateName
Fields.Description: Denormalized template name for display. Set at creation from the template's Name field.

Fields.Name: CustomOutputStatusId
Fields.Description: FK to MRSCustomStatus.StatusId. Stamped when a reviewer completes the review with a workflow-backed custom status (OutputStatus becomes Reviewed). Null for legacy Approved/Rejected completions on templates that don't map to a workflow.

Fields.Name: IsE2ETest
Fields.Description: Flag indicating this output was created by an end-to-end test run. Used to filter test data from production views.

Fields.Name: CorrelationId
Fields.Description: Correlation ID passed from the frontend to tie telemetry events across the processing pipeline back to the originating user action.

Fields.Name: StorageBucketName
Fields.Description: Name of the storage bucket containing the source PDF. Stored alongside MRSPacketLocation so the viewer can resolve the bucket without extra lookups.

Fields.Name: ExternalReferenceId
Fields.Description: Customer-supplied join key, mirrored from MRSExternalFileReference at load-file-data time. Lets downstream consumers resolve the MRS2Output row by their own identifier without going through MRS IDs.

Fields.Name: OutputStatus
Fields.Description: Current processing/review status of the output. Values: pending, processing, ready, completed, approved, rejected, faulted. Drives the output state machine and UI filtering.

Fields.Name: CitationsFile
Fields.Description: File attachment containing JSON citations data. Single source of truth — replaces the dual MRSDeepRagCitations text field and MRSCitationsFile file.

Fields.Name: ReviewDurationMinutes
Fields.Description: Computed: minutes from StartedWorkingAt to CompletedAt. Set on approve/reject for server-side AVG aggregation.

Fields.Name: IngestionSourceId
Fields.Description: FK reference to MRS2IngestionSource.SourceId. Denormalized for query performance — identifies which ingestion source produced this output.

Data.Name: MRS2TemplateTestResult
Data.Description: Stores test run results for template versions. Replaces MRSTemplateTestResultOutput with TTR prefix removed from all field names. Content fields use file-only storage (text duplicates removed).

Fields.Name: CitationsFile
Fields.Description: File attachment containing the test run citations (JSON). Single source of truth — replaces the dual TTRCitations text field and TTRCitationsFile file.

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Current status of the test run. Values: pending, running, completed, failed. Replaces TTRStatus with the TTR prefix removed.

Fields.Name: OutputFile
Fields.Description: File attachment containing the test run output (markdown summary). Single source of truth — replaces the dual TTROutput text field and TTROutputFile file.

Fields.Name: OrchJobId
Fields.Description: UiPath Orchestrator job ID for the test run. Used to track job status and retrieve logs.

Fields.Name: TemplateVersionId
Fields.Description: FK reference to MRS2TemplateVersion.TemplateVersionId. Identifies which template version was tested. Replaces TTRTemplateVersionId.

Fields.Name: CorrelationId
Fields.Description: Correlation ID passed from the frontend to tie telemetry events across the processing pipeline back to the originating user action.

Fields.Name: ErrorMessage
Fields.Description: Error details when Status is faulted. Contains the exception message from the processing pipeline.

Fields.Name: TestResultId
Fields.Description: Business key for the test result. Replaces TTRId with the TTR prefix removed.

Fields.Name: SamplePacketLocation
Fields.Description: Storage Bucket path to the sample PDF used for this test run. Replaces TTRSamplePacketLocation with the TTR prefix removed.

Fields.Name: CreatedDate
Fields.Description: Application-managed creation date. Preserves original date during migration. New records set this to current timestamp.

Fields.Name: InstanceId
Fields.Description: Orchestrator job instance ID — used to trace back to the job logs in Orchestrator for this record.

Data.Name: MedicalDenialV2
Data.Description: Core per-claim denial record. Source of truth for status, denial metadata, and the six agent output file attachments. Upstream data pipeline writes Status='Ingested' rows; DiscoveryAgent flips to Dispatched; agents flip through Analyzing → Analyzed → AppealGenerated (or CompletedNoAppeal). Sweeper marks Failed for stuck runs.

Fields.Name: PreventionAgentResultFile
Fields.Description: Attachment: PreventionAgent output JSON. Read by PreventionRecommendationAgent during nightly clustering.

Fields.Name: AppealAgentResultFile
Fields.Description: Attachment: AppealAgent output JSON (appeal letter + tracking).

Fields.Name: EditedAppealLetterFile
Fields.Description: Attachment: human-edited appeal letter text (reviewer correction). Preferred over AppealAgentResultFile in the UI when present; the original stays intact so (original -> edited) is a clean feedback/training diff.

Fields.Name: SubmittedAt
Fields.Description: When a user marked the appeal submitted in the frontend. Null until submission.

Fields.Name: ClaimId
Fields.Description: Primary claim identifier. Numeric for Deaconess, 'S'-prefixed for Vandalia. Used by every agent to upsert by claim.

Fields.Name: DenialReason
Fields.Description: Short denial-reason text (CARC/RARC descriptions). ClaimsAgent truncates to 200 chars.

Fields.Name: SubmissionStatus
Fields.Description: Human appeal-submission state, set from the frontend (e.g. 'NotSubmitted' / 'Submitted'). Distinct from Status='AppealGenerated', which only means the pipeline generated a letter — this tracks whether a user actually submitted it.

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: State machine value. One of: Ingested, Dispatched, Analyzing, Analyzed, AppealGenerated, CompletedNoAppeal, Failed.

Fields.Name: PrimaryRootCause
Fields.Description: RcaAgent's canonical primary root-cause category (one of the 8 registered categories, e.g. clinical-documentation, authorization-referral). Promoted to a queryable column so the dashboard can aggregate the root-cause distribution without fanning out to every RcaAgent attachment. Sized generously to allow longer/compound category labels.

Fields.Name: RunContextJson
Fields.Description: Cumulative JSON blob. Top-level keys: run_id, pipeline (bucket_name + blob_file_path), dispatcher (dispatched_at + maestro_job_key + attempt + last_error), claims_agent / clinical_agent / policy_agent / rca_agent / appeal_agent / prevention_agent (each {run_id, status, timestamp}).

Fields.Name: RecommendedAction
Fields.Description: RcaAgent's recommended next step (Appeal / Rebill / Do not pursue / Needs review).

Fields.Name: DenialDate
Fields.Description: ClaimsAgent's parsed denial_date at UTC midnight, ISO 8601. Promoted to a queryable column so tables/dashboards can sort/filter/aggregate on the true denial date (the ClaimsAgent attachment JSON can't be queried; CreateTime is ingest time, which can lag the denial by weeks). Same value AppealDeadline is derived from. Null when denial_date is missing/unparseable.

Fields.Name: AppealDeadline
Fields.Description: Computed by ClaimsAgent from denial_date + per-payer days.

Fields.Name: AccountClass
Fields.Description: Encounter type / care setting (Inpatient, Outpatient, Observation, etc.).

Fields.Name: ProviderType
Fields.Description: Type of storage provider. Values: storage_bucket. Azure-specific types have been removed.

Fields.Name: DisplayName

Fields.Name: StorageBucketName
Fields.Description: Name of the UiPath Storage Bucket to poll. Extracted from ConnectionConfig JSON for direct querying.

Fields.Name: SourceId
Fields.Description: Business key for the ingestion source. Referenced by MRS2Template.IngestionSourceId and MRS2IngestionState.IngestionSourceId.

Fields.Name: CronExpression
Fields.Description: Cron expression defining the polling schedule. Extracted from ConnectionConfig JSON for direct querying.

Fields.Name: RootPath
Fields.Description: Root path within the Storage Bucket to scan for files.

Fields.Name: ScheduleId
Fields.Description: UiPath Orchestrator schedule ID for the ingestion polling job. Extracted from ConnectionConfig JSON for direct querying.

Fields.Name: PollIntervalMinutes
Fields.Description: How often (in minutes) the source is polled for new files. Fixed to integer precision.

Fields.Name: ConnectionConfig
Fields.Description: JSON configuration for connection-specific settings not extracted as top-level fields. Contains remaining config that does not need to be queried directly.

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether this ingestion source is active and should be polled. Replaces 'IngestionSourceIsActive' with consistent naming.

Fields.Name: FilePattern
Fields.Description: Glob pattern to filter which files are ingested from the source (e.g., '*.pdf'). Only matching files are processed.

Fields.Name: CreatedDate
Fields.Description: Application-managed creation date. Preserves original date during migration. New records set this to current timestamp.

Fields.Name: FileName

Fields.Name: RetryCount

Fields.Name: CleanupComplete
Fields.Description: Flag indicating whether post-processing cleanup (e.g., temporary file removal) has been completed for this ingestion file.

Fields.Name: IngestionSourceId

Fields.Name: LastRetryDate
Fields.Description: Timestamp of the most recent retry attempt for this file.

Fields.Name: ManualFileLocation

Fields.Name: FilePath
Fields.Description: Full path to the source file within the Storage Bucket. Replaces BlobPath. Uniqueness is no longer enforced — discovery dedupes via FileUploadTime + the IngestionState watermark instead.

Fields.Name: FileUploadTime
Fields.Description: Source-bucket upload timestamp for the file. Set by discovery (from the bucket SDK's last_modified, or the legacy YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SS folder name) and used as the per-file watermark key for deduplication.

Fields.Name: ManualBatchId
Fields.Description: FK reference to MRS2ManualBatch.ManualBatchId. Present only when this file was uploaded via manual batch. Null for automated ingestion.

Fields.Name: InstanceId
Fields.Description: Orchestrator job instance ID — used to trace back to the job logs in Orchestrator for this record.

Fields.Name: IsManualUpload
Fields.Description: Flag indicating whether this file was manually uploaded (true) or discovered via automated ingestion (false). Replaces the ambiguous 'Manual' field.

Fields.Name: TemplateVersionId
Fields.Description: FK reference to MRS2TemplateVersion.TemplateVersionId. Identifies which template version should be used to process this file.

Fields.Name: ClaimedBy
Fields.Description: Dispatcher claim token. Set when a poll-and-dispatch instance claims this file for processing. Used to prevent duplicate processing when multiple dispatchers run concurrently.

Fields.Name: ErrorMessage
Fields.Description: Error details when IngestionFileStatus is faulted. Contains the exception message from the processing pipeline.

Data.Name: MRSCustomStatus
Data.Description: A single reviewer-selectable status (e.g. "Approve", "Reject") owned by an MRSWorkflow and pinned to exactly one fixed platform state. Custom statuses drive what appears in the review action dropdown; they do NOT change the underlying MRS2Output.OutputStatus enum (which remains the platform's fixed state machine). Each status belongs to exactly one workflow — statuses are not shared across workflows.

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional longer explanation of the status shown as tooltip / helper text in admin.

Fields.Name: WorkflowId
Fields.Description: FK to MRSWorkflow.WorkflowId. Statuses are scoped to one workflow — not shared across workflows.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display label shown in the Complete Review dropdown.

Fields.Name: StatusId
Fields.Description: Business key. Stable identifier used by MRS2Output.CustomOutputStatusId and by feedback metadata's mrsReviewStatusId.

Data.Name: MRS2IngestionState
Data.Description: Tracks the current ingestion state for a source, including the last processed folder date. Used by the polling pipeline to determine which files are new since the last scan.

Fields.Name: IngestionStateId
Fields.Description: Identifier for the type of ingestion state being tracked. Legacy default was 'AzurePdfScanState'; new records should use 'StorageBucketScanState'.

Fields.Name: CreatedDate
Fields.Description: Application-managed creation date. Preserves original date during migration. New records set this to current timestamp.

Fields.Name: IngestionSourceId
Fields.Description: FK reference to MRS2IngestionSource.SourceId. Links this state to its ingestion source. Replaces 'StateIngestionSourceId' with the redundant prefix removed.

Fields.Name: LastProcessedFolderDate
Fields.Description: The date of the last processed folder, stored as NVARCHAR with a 'zz' prefix as a workaround for a known Data Fabric datetime sorting bug. The FE strips this prefix on read and re-adds it on write. Will be converted to DATETIMEOFFSET when the platform bug is confirmed fixed.

Data.Name: MRS2OutputAssignment
Data.Description: Tracks the current assignment state for an output record. Split from MRSOutput to separate processing concerns from reviewer assignment concerns. One record per output.

Fields.Name: CreatedDate
Fields.Description: Application-managed creation date. Preserves original date during migration. New records set this to current timestamp.

Fields.Name: AssigneeName
Fields.Description: Display name of the currently assigned reviewer. Denormalized for UI display without additional lookups.

Fields.Name: OutputId
Fields.Description: FK reference to MRS2Output.OutputId. One-to-one relationship — each output has exactly one assignment record.

Fields.Name: AssigneeId
Fields.Description: UiPath user ID of the currently assigned reviewer. Null when the output is unassigned.

Fields.Name: AssignedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp when the current assignment was made. Reset on each reassignment.

Fields.Name: AssigneeEmail
Fields.Description: Email address of the currently assigned reviewer. Used for notification workflows.

Fields.Name: StartedWorkingAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp when the assigned reviewer started actively working on the output. Used for time-tracking and SLA calculations.

Fields.Name: CreatedDate

Fields.Name: FileName

Data.Name: MRSWorkflow
Data.Description: Defines a named workflow mapping that groups custom review statuses under fixed platform-controlled states. Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Optional longer explanation of the workflow's purpose.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display name shown in the workflow management UI.

Fields.Name: WorkflowId
Fields.Description: Business key. Stable identifier used by MRS2Template.WorkflowId and MRSCustomStatus.WorkflowId.
